Name: MIMICRY_ESTABLISHMENT_TEX_PARAM_ST
Description: Disguise (Mimic's Veil) slot rules per part of the map, from the second map info texture's red channel. Appears unused by the game: that lookup only runs on m61 maps, which use MimicryEstablishmentTexParam_m61. Retail has a single default row.

Fields.Name: Source Image Colour: Red
Fields.Description: Red of this area's colour in the painted source map image; the converted texture holds the row ID itself. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Source Image Colour: Green
Fields.Description: Green of this area's colour in the painted source map image; the converted texture holds the row ID itself. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Source Image Colour: Blue
Fields.Description: Blue of this area's colour in the painted source map image; the converted texture holds the row ID itself. Appears unused by the game.

Fields.Name: Map Mimicry Establishment Param ID
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. The disguise slot weights come from the MapMimicryEstablishmentParam row of the current play region.
